title: sebastiania glandulosa var. pohlii
intro: Sebastiania glandulosa var. pohlii, commonly known as Pohl's Sebastiania, is a plant species in the Euphorbiaceae family, native to Brazil. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, offering potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Pohl's Sebastiania include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antiproliferative properties, which may contribute to its potential in cancer treatment and other therapeutic applications. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
